title: Register your business for Goods and Services Tax (GST)
summary: This page explains how and why you must register your business for Goods and Services Tax (GST).

faqs.a: GST is a tax of 10% on most goods and services sold in Australia.

faqs.q: How can I register for GST?
faqs.a: You can register for GST online using the Australian Government's Online services for business.

faqs.q: What do I need to register for GST?
faqs.a: You need an Australian Business Number (ABN) and the myGovID app on a smart device, which must be linked to your ABN through the Relationship Authorisation Manager (RAM).
